name: smtp-utf8-rfc822-mailbox-permit-diff-domain-invalid
description: A mailbox-form rfc822 permit (alice@example.com) does not authorize a SmtpUTF8Mailbox SAN at a different domain (alice@other.com). Both the strict-RFC-9549 reading (domain mismatch) and Botan-conservative reading (mailbox-form does not apply at all) reject this leaf - no implementation should accept it.
notes: Negative counterpart to `smtp-utf8-rfc822-mailbox-permit-strict-9549-same-domain-valid`. Used to confirm that strict-9549 implementations still reject when the domain doesn't match.
